rankings.good: The waiver QBs saved him. Shough (53.9 in two games) and Bryce Young (48.6) are real, and JT is still the RB1 with 61.5.
rankings.bad: The roster is a hospital. AJ Brown is on IR until at least week 6 with a high ankle, Goedert sprained his MCL, Pierce is on IR with his heel and Jacobs is on the exempt list facing a suspension. Saquon has 21.0 points in three weeks.

rankings.good: McBride is a weekly 16+ at TE (24.5, 18.1, 16.5), TLaw has two 25+ games and Geno came off waivers with 33.2. Puka is expected back this week from the hip.
rankings.bad: The injuries. Achane tore his ACL and is done for the year, Etienne's hamstring will cost him time and Caleb has a grade 2 hamstring that'll keep him out 3 to 4 weeks. 0-3 with two of the losses by under 8.
rankings.takeaway: Pray Puka is good and doesn't say any racist stuff on a livestream during the season.. or bite anyone again.

rankings.good: The skill guys are there. Chase has 51.3 the last two weeks after a slow opener, Hubbard and Kyren both have 50+, and Michael Wilson just went for 25.9.
rankings.bad: QB, which is a problem in superflex. Hurts has gone 32.6, 18.6, 11.5 and Maye has 13.2 total including a -1.2. Lowest scoring team in the league at 105 a game.

rankings.good: CeeDee (70.9) and Watson (69.4) are one of the best WR duos in the league. Bowers came back with 27.6 and Jeremiyah Love just had his first big game (21.9).
rankings.bad: Superflex with no quarterback. Dart had season ending knee surgery and Daniels dislocated his elbow for the third time in a year. Until Daniels is back it's Penix and Mariota.
rankings.takeaway: Brock Bowers might be enough to bring you back. This year's JSN.

rankings.good: 3rd in the league in points, so 1-2 is bad luck more than anything. ARSB (75.8) and Olave (70.5) are a top WR duo, Stafford bounced back with 35.9 and 24.3, and CMC has 20+ the last two weeks.
rankings.bad: QB consistency. Stafford opened with 2.9 and Herbert has 36.8 in three games. He just picked up Kirk Cousins, which tells you how he feels about it.
rankings.takeaway: This is just a second half team. Just like Bo Nix.

rankings.good: Bijan is back to being Bijan, 35.3 last week and 2nd in the NFL in rushing. Garrett Wilson is the real WR1, 57.3 points and better every week, and Kelce still has it (49.1).
rankings.bad: The receivers he drafted to win with haven't shown up. Nabers is healthy, he just hasn't produced yet (21.6 points in three games), and Rice has 38.0. Baker is out at least 3 weeks with a dislocated throwing thumb, so Deshaun Watson is the QB2.
rankings.takeaway: All hail Bijan. In Bijan you trust. Pray for 1000 years of prosperity for Bijan.

rankings.good: Gibbs is the best player in fantasy, 96.3 points with a 41.4 last week, and Dak (79.9) plus Burrow (67.2) is a strong QB pair. London finally broke out with 28.4.
rankings.bad: RB2. Behind Gibbs it's Rhamondre, RJ Harvey, Monangai and Woody Marks, and none of them have stuck. Rhamondre has 22.9 points in three games.
rankings.takeaway: If you had just drafted a second running back.... this team is a wagon.

rankings.good: Allen is a cheat code (42.3 and 48.9 before a 13.3 dud) and Jordan Love has 19+ in every game in the OP. Henry, Swift and Javonte give him one of the deepest RB rooms in the league.
rankings.bad: Everything rides on Allen. The week he put up 13.3, the team scored 123.5 and lost. TE is a weekly guess (Kincaid went 18.0, 22.5, then 1.8) and McConkey has 36.3 total.
rankings.takeaway: Live and die by Josh Allen. Fortunately he will have many more good days than bad.

rankings.good: Purdy has been the best QB in the league. 103.3 points and better every week (26.9, 35.0, 41.4). Add Lamar and three straight 20+ weeks from K9 and the core is elite.
rankings.bad: The receivers. JJ has gone 31.2, 8.5, 5.2 and McMillan has 27.3 total. 3-0 with the 5th most points means the record is ahead of the roster.
rankings.takeaway: Brock Purdy is the steal of the draft. Him and Lamar can carry.

rankings.good: The best roster in the league and it isn't close. JSN has 103.5 points, 28 more than any other WR in the league. Goff (88.5) and Mahomes (84.1) are the best QB pair in superflex, and Stroud is a third starter sitting on the bench.
rankings.bad: WR2. Behind JSN it's Burden, Jameson Williams and Addison, all boom or bust, and Nico has missed two games with a hamstring. Jeanty has 22.6 points the last two weeks after a 32.7 opener.
rankings.takeaway: How did every team pass on JSN in round one?
